title: The bound a set of prices proves
heading: Any Nonnegative Prices on the Rows Give an Upper Bound
cases: prices that cover every activity's value prove their bound, and prices that leave one uncovered prove nothing
prices whose column sums equal an activity's value exactly still cover it
a negative price on a <= row makes the prices unusable, even if they cover every activity
an activity with a positive value that no row limits can never be covered
a row's price is weighted by the activity's coefficient in that row
